data.name: Demon Street
data.detailed_description:
Become the last light in a demon-infested city

Demons have devoured the soul of a modern metropolis. Street by street, block by block, the city sinks into neon-soaked despair—until you arrive. As the LightBringer, you’re thrown into a VR roguelite bullet-hell where every run is a desperate exorcism and every shot is a prayer.

Cleanse the streets, face manifestations of human vice, and push through waves of cursed projectiles in a dark, stylized world of harsh contrast and toxic, multicolored bloom.

------------------------------------------------------------------

VR ROGUELITE BULLET-HELL

This is a VR-only shooter built around high speed, dodging, and constant decision-making:

  • Squeeze through dense bullet patterns in full VR, dodging with your whole body—not just your controller.

  • Make meaningful choices every run—pick perks, weapons, and routes.

  • Fall, learn, grow stronger, and return—the city won’t cleanse itself.

------------------------------------------------------------------

FIVE WEAPONS, EACH WITH ITS OWN TWIST

You’re not bringing mercy—you’re bringing tools of purification. Each weapon has a special firing mode and distinct feel in VR:

  • Lighters – flame pistols that turn precise shots into incendiary bursts.

  • Neon Sabers – glowing energy blades for stylish close-quarters exorcisms.

  • Accumulators – tesla machine guns spitting chains of electric arcs.

  • Radiators – radioactive blaster-shotguns that melt anything up close.

  • Icicles – ice rifles that freeze, slow, and control the battlefield.

------------------------------------------------------------------

Experiment, swap weapons between encounters, and combine them with perks to create your own style of demon-cleansing.

------------------------------------------------------------------

BOSSES BORN FROM HUMAN VICES

Face a demonic hierarchy built from the worst in humanity:

  • 12 demon bosses ruling over different streets.

  • 4 mega bosses that break the usual rules of combat.

  • Prideful Death – the ultimate embodiment of decay and sin.

------------------------------------------------------------------

Each boss embodies a human vice—sorrow, rage, gluttony, lust, pride, and more—with attack patterns and phases themed around their sin. Learn them, punish their openings, and drag their corruption into the light.

------------------------------------------------------------------

80+ PERKS THAT REACT TO HOW YOU PLAY

Your build is more than just “more damage”. Perks in this game respond to your actions and the current combat situation:

  • Raise survivability with shields, healing, and clutch life-saving effects.

  • Unlock new firing modes and shot patterns for your weapons.

  • Modify damage based on movement, aggression, positioning, and other run conditions.

  • Stack synergies and turn a simple gun into a full-on exorcism engine.

------------------------------------------------------------------

With each run you’ll discover new perk combinations and interactions—from subtle boosts to absolutely broken builds.

------------------------------------------------------------------

A DARK YET STYLIZED NEON CITY

Wander through a modern city that’s both grim and stylized:

  • High contrast visuals with saturated, multicolored neon bloom.

  • Demonic sigils, corrupted streets, and former residents twisted into silhouettes.

  • A mix of urban decay and otherworldly chaos.

------------------------------------------------------------------

This isn’t realistic horror—it’s a readable, vivid bullet-hell arena built for VR.

------------------------------------------------------------------

KEY FEATURES

  • VR-only roguelite bullet-hell shooter.

  • Play as the LightBringer and cleanse a demon-infested modern city.

  • 5 unique weapon types, each with a special firing mode.

  • 80+ perks that change how you shoot, move, and survive.

  • 12 demon bosses, 4 mega bosses, and 1 ultra boss inspired by human vices.

  • Stylized dark neon visuals with high contrast and colorful bloom.

  • Replayable “street by street” structure: every run pushes you deeper into the city’s corruption.

------------------------------------------------------------------

Demons already own the city. The only question is: how many runs will it take you to take it back?
